name: Atly
summary: Review-based place discovery: where to go for an intent (work-friendly, gluten-free, first date) near a location, with reasons.

api_key.description: an Atly API key (create one by POSTing an email to /keys; it raises the quota from the small shared hourly IP allowance to a daily one)

notes: No key is required: anonymous callers share a small hourly quota per IP. A key gives a daily quota.

Every metered response carries X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining and X-RateLimit-Reset; each metered request counts one unit, errors included. Reference calls (categories, areas, key info, docs) are free.
Never reuse a place id or category from examples; ids come only from live responses. Every response includes a call_id.
API v1 was retired on 2026-10-26; this entry targets v2.

endpoints.name: Find places for an intent near a location
endpoints.summary: Places ranked for one or more intents (categories such as Coffee or Work Friendly) in a city, area or radius, with quotable review reasons.

categories.description: 1 to 5 category names or ids, most important first; every result matches all (trailing ones are dropped if nothing matches). Names must be exact; look them up with atly.places.list_categories.

area_id.description: An area id from atly.places.list_areas, or a city name such as Austin. Give this or lat and lon, not both.

lat.description: Latitude of the search centre, -90 to 90.

lon.description: Longitude of the search centre, -180 to 180.

radius_km.description: Radius with lat and lon, in km, held to 0.2-50. Default 5.

limit.description: Places to return, at most 25. Default 10.

place_type.description: Up to 5 Google place-type words to keep, matched as whole words, such as restaurant or coffee. Applied to the strongest 400 places and never relaxed.

notes: A read over POST: it searches and changes nothing. Scores are 0-10 and relative to other places in the same country; a place with no score is unmeasured, not bad.
Counts one unit against your quota (every metered call, errors included). If no place matches every category, trailing categories are dropped and dropped_categories says which.
Coverage is mostly the United States, with pockets in Mexico, Israel and Thailand.

endpoints.name: Get one place
endpoints.summary: Profile, hours, category scores, quotable statements, good-to-know facts and the Atly link for a place.

id.description: A place id from atly.places.search, or an atly.com place link or slug (URL-encode a link).

notes: Counts one unit against your quota.

endpoints.name: List intent categories
endpoints.summary: Atly's categories, optionally matched against words such as coffee or dog friendly.

q.description: Words to match against category names and keywords.

notes: Free: reference calls do not count against your quota.

endpoints.name: List supported areas
endpoints.summary: Cities, neighborhoods and states Atly covers, with ids for place searches.

q.description: Area name or abbreviation, such as san diego or nyc.

notes: Free: reference calls do not count against your quota.

endpoints.name: Show my key and quota
endpoints.summary: Your key's tier and remaining quota; without a key, the anonymous allowance for your IP.
notes: Free: does not count against your quota.
